title: The wrong size
cost: You feel too small for your life because you measure yourself against everything that happens
question: What exactly is being measured: the body, a passing thought, or the awareness in which both are known?
recognition: Do not confuse the fact of being aware with an inflated claim that you are personally omnipotent
return: When the next small task arrives, do it at its actual scale

title: The knot called mine
cost: A familiar worry always returns carrying your name
question: Can you describe the worry as a thought with a beginning and an end rather than as the entirety of yourself?
recognition: The possessive 'mine' is a grammatical habit; a metaphysical claim about self requires further argument
return: Tell the truth about the worry and take any needed action

title: A history mistaken for a self
cost: Your biography seems to exhaust what you are
question: Who knows the story at this moment, and which details must be recalled for that knowing to occur?
recognition: Autobiography matters ethically and psychologically, but narrative memory does not function exactly like immediate awareness
return: Remember what matters without making the story a prison

title: The desire for completion
cost: You postpone life until a future spiritual state arrives
question: How would you know the promised state had come, and who would make that judgment?
recognition: The longing for an experience can become another object of attachment
return: Resume today's concrete obligation without cancelling the longer search

title: The fact of appearing
cost: Before you judge a sight, it is already given as experience
question: Can you find a sensation that appears to you without any appearing at all?
recognition: The question concerns the conditions of experience, not whether the physical world is mind-made
return: Describe what is present before interpreting it

title: The certainty and its limits
cost: You are more certain that you are experiencing than that your interpretation is correct
question: Which claim is immediate: that something is appearing, or why it appears?
recognition: Do not infer that every appearance is true; self-evidence of experience differs from certainty about objects
return: Correct your beliefs when better evidence arrives

title: Attention does not create everything
cost: Concentrating on an object seems to make it more real
question: What changes when attention turns away: the object's existence, or your present acquaintance with it?
recognition: Trika's emphasis on consciousness does not mean your private attention manufactures other people
return: Look back at the object and allow its independence to matter

title: The missing second lamp
cost: You seek another witness to prove the first act of knowing
question: If one act of knowing required a second knower, what would establish the second?
recognition: The regress of recognition invites a self-luminous account, but it is an argument, not a word trick
return: Notice an ordinary perception without demanding an inner spectator

title: The body as visible
cost: You say 'I am my body' and then look at your hand
question: Is the body experienced as known, and does its being known settle what the subject is?
recognition: The body is indispensable to ordinary life; a distinction between knower and known is not contempt for embodiment
return: Care for the body that allows your life to continue

title: A thought can be noticed
cost: A thought says 'this is who I am'
question: Does every thought that appears have to be the entire subject of appearing?
recognition: Witnessing language can help, but treating awareness as a hidden internal object creates a new problem
return: Let the thought finish before acting on it

title: The ache of agency
cost: You cannot tell whether you really choose
question: Where in experience do you meet intention, action, hindsight and their differences?
recognition: Agency requires philosophical argument; immediate feeling cannot settle free will by itself
return: Own your next choice without inventing certainty about its metaphysics

title: The word I
cost: The same pronoun attaches to child, adult, tired, joyful and grieving
question: What allows one word to serve across so many changing predicates?
recognition: Grammar reveals continuity of reference but not a proof of an eternal individual soul
return: Use the pronoun responsibly rather than worshipping it

title: The cup on the table
cost: An ordinary cup seems entirely outside the act of knowing
question: What in the description belongs to the cup, and what to your present experience of it?
recognition: Distinguish epistemic access from the cup's physical existence; recognition is not solipsism
return: Drink the water instead of trying to dissolve the cup

title: Colour is relational
cost: The same cloth looks different in noon and twilight
question: Does a change of appearance entail that no real cloth exists?
recognition: An appearance has conditions; an account of consciousness need not deny those conditions
return: Look again under better light when accuracy matters

title: Difference without distance
cost: You can distinguish a sound from a thought without making either unreal
question: Do differences in experience require absolute separation from the fact of awareness?
recognition: Nonduality must allow genuine distinctions rather than forcing every object into a vague sameness
return: Name what is different with care

title: The world is not a private dream
cost: Other people's pain refuses to behave like your chosen image
question: What keeps you from using metaphysics to minimise an other's reality?
recognition: The world may be interpreted as manifestation without excusing indifference or cruelty
return: Answer a person rather than a theory

title: Another first person
cost: You meet someone who also says 'I'
question: What changes when your account of experience must accommodate their own first-person life?
recognition: An expansive account of consciousness has to make room for more than one's private certainty
return: Listen long enough to discover an unexpected fact

title: The argument
cost: A disagreement feels like proof that the other is foreign to you
question: Can a shared situation contain genuine incompatible judgments?
recognition: Recognition should enlarge the space for disagreement, not dissolve it by declaration
return: State their position fairly before replying

title: The obligation
cost: You recognise a neighbour's need while busy with something important
question: Does identifying yourself as universal make you more or less accountable to this person?
recognition: Any spiritual insight that removes ordinary obligation needs severe scrutiny
return: Help if you can; otherwise answer truthfully

title: The name offered back
cost: A person's name is spoken with care
question: What is honoured when you use another's own chosen name?
recognition: Speech is relation in action; devotional metaphysics cannot replace basic courtesy
return: Say the name correctly and ask when uncertain

title: Wanting
cost: Desire appears before you have formed a plan
question: Can you distinguish wanting, judging and acting, even when they arrive almost together?
recognition: The triad of will, knowledge and action is a philosophical framework for these differences
return: Choose whether to pursue the desire after considering consequences

title: Knowing
cost: You perceive an object and then make a claim about it
question: What makes a perception sufficient or insufficient reason for a judgment?
recognition: Śakti as cognition is not a licence to call guesses revelation
return: Check the claim against evidence

title: Doing
cost: A decision becomes a movement of the body
question: Which abilities and constraints made the action possible?
recognition: Action can be read as participation in a wider field, while responsibility remains particular
return: Finish the act you began or explicitly stop it

title: The three not three things
cost: Wanting, understanding and acting can be separated in analysis
question: Are they independent substances or distinguishable functions within one situation?
recognition: The triad's nondual reading is not a denial that real action can fail
return: Correct the action when knowledge changes

title: A precise pause
cost: You notice a gap between impulse and response
question: Does the gap require prolonged breath control or can it be noticed ordinarily?
recognition: Some traditional practices attend to intervals, but a modern pause must be named as a modern suggestion
return: Answer after checking what is actually being asked

title: The question who
cost: You turn from object to the felt fact of knowing
question: Are you finding a second object called the witness?
recognition: An inner inquiry is a method only if its source, instructions and limits are identified
return: Return to the conversation you were in

title: The word and the hearing
cost: You repeat a word until its sound becomes clear
question: Which aspects are phonetic, semantic and devotional?
recognition: Mantra practices vary; not every word is a consecrated mantra and not every phoneme implies a deity
return: Let pronunciation become accurate without making it a contest

title: Without a method
cost: A moment of clarity comes while no practice is underway
question: Does its spontaneity prove that all preparation was useless?
recognition: Anupāya is a doctrinal category, not a universal excuse to abandon disciplines
return: Do not perform the clarity; continue normally

title: The danger of a sign
cost: You wait for warmth, light or a sudden sensation
question: Why would any one bodily event be proof of liberation?
recognition: No reliable equation maps one sensation to ultimate spiritual success
return: Notice the sensation if it occurs and do not chase it

title: Fewer excuses
cost: After reflection, an old excuse seems less persuasive
question: Does your conduct become more accountable or merely more self-congratulatory?
recognition: Changes in behaviour are worth noticing but are not metaphysical proof
return: Make one repair rather than announce progress

title: The return of confusion
cost: You lose a clear feeling and conclude you have fallen
question: Was the clear feeling itself the truth, or one temporary condition?
recognition: Recognition cannot be reduced to the duration of an altered mood
return: Resume a reasonable routine

title: Compassion without display
cost: A chance to help appears with no audience
question: Are you doing it because it is needed or because it confirms an identity?
recognition: Quiet action can be ethically valuable without needing sacred self-description
return: Do it if you can and move on

title: The breakfast bowl
cost: Breakfast is exactly as it was yesterday
question: What has changed, if anything, in the way you meet a simple object?
recognition: A philosophy that cannot coexist with dishes and hunger has not yet reached ordinary life
return: Eat and wash the bowl

title: The unanswered message
cost: Someone has not replied, and theories bloom
question: Can you distinguish actual evidence from a story produced by uncertainty?
recognition: Recognition doesn't exempt you from communication or the limits of knowing another
return: Write clearly if a reply is needed

title: The difficult apology
cost: You understand your reasoning and still caused harm
question: Does insight erase the act or make acknowledgment more urgent?
recognition: A language of universal agency must never swallow particular responsibility
return: Apologise without metaphysical decoration

title: The road home
cost: After a great journey the same street waits
question: What need be added to the world for the street to be encountered directly?
recognition: The ordinary is not a disappointing substitute for awakening; it is where every claim is tested
return: Unlock the door, greet the people inside, and stay
